label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= ~80) after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1 or D2) and only late in the episode: zero activity before trial ~60, with the rate rising steeply over trials 70-99 (71% of activation mass in trials 90-99). Within that span it strongly prefers GO after an unrewarded previous trial (in_rew = 0 at D1; prev_reward = 0 accounts for 94% of mass, and it never fires when the reward input is 1 at the current step). It tracks the model value head being low (all mass at value < 7.1), consistent with an end-of-episode / low-expected-return signal. Magnitude grows with episode trial and is largest after no-reward trials; weak activations (bottom quartile) occur late after rewarded trials. It is not selective for action, reached state, transition type, or stay/switch. On dev, (GO & ep_trial >= 80 & prev_reward == 0) gives F1 0.59 with mass recall 0.91. Precision is limited because the late-episode onset is graded rather than a sharp cutoff, and recall is limited by weak late firing after rewarded trials. It uses only observed variables (elapsed time and the observed previous reward).
